title: Physics leftovers audit — no behavior change
summary: An audit of remaining physics notes found two items already working and one no longer reproducing, and it explained most of the residual tire/terrain overlap. No gameplay behavior changed; the only code change is a regression test. Host verification only.
details: Stale notes corrected: the thrown rider already collides with plant proxies and with Arlington's moving train bodies during wrecks. A new regression test confirms that moving-body point velocity drags the rider. Shipped in PR #134 (merge a118ed8).

ENV03 straight-throttle boundary stranding no longer reproduces on current main: 3/3 env03 and 1/1 env04 runs passed, and 1,500 steps from the old stranded pose ran without stranding. The original has no stuck timer, so none was added.

Residual tire/terrain overlap, explained: about 0.22 ft comes from one-frame ordering (springs are evaluated before integration and the frame is drawn after, as the original does), suspension bottoming on hard cross-slope landings, and single centre-plane contact per wheel. The vertical measurement also overstates the penetration by about 20% at 35 degrees. Ruled out: post-loop correction, smooth normals, wheel radius mismatch. About 0.12 ft remains unattributed.
limitation: Host verification only; not publicly verified or checked on a physical phone. About 0.12 ft of residual overlap is still unattributed, and original-game handling fidelity is not claimed.
caption: Host capture of ENV03 riding at 54 mph from the old stranding pose; it no longer strands. A second capture of the ENV03 boundary-launch frame with the debug overlay was also inspected.
